stops.stop: Vienna, Zentralfriedhof, group 32A, number 52
stops.date_confidence: the grave is attested: de.wikipedia and Wien Geschichte Wiki both give Ehrengrab, Gruppe 32 A, Nummer 52, and de.wikipedia carries a photograph of the stone. The date is flagged: the dossier's 'reinterred November 1915' is not in the cited article, which gives group and number with no burial or reinterment date at all, so the year here orders the segment only and the November 1915 reinterment is not repeated as fact. The Ehrengrab's current administrative renewal status could not be confirmed; the Friedhöfe Wien grave-search URL attempted returned 404. Pin inherited byte for byte from carl_menger.journey.json; the dossier's 16.4494 lies well east of the honorary-grave core.

stops.segment: The Grave, the Courtyard, the Banknote
stops.stop: Vienna, the bronze in the Arkadenhof
stops.date_confidence: attested, and upgraded from the dossier's flag: Wien Geschichte Wiki's 'Böhm-Bawerk-Denkmal' entry places the memorial at 1., Universitätsring 1, in the University of Vienna's Arkadenhof, created 1950, unveiled 23 June 1950, by E. Delug, and records it as still extant. The dossier had carried this as unconfirmed. Pin is the university's Ringstrasse building, inherited from carl_menger.journey.json.

stops.segment: The Grave, the Courtyard, the Banknote
stops.stop: Vienna, the last hundred-schilling note
stops.date_confidence: attested in outline: en.wikipedia states that his image appeared on the hundred-schilling banknote from 1984 until the euro was introduced in 2002. The precise dates relayed in the dossier, designed 2 January 1984, issued 14 October 1985, withdrawn as legal tender 28 February 2002, rest on the dossier plus that looser summary; the OeNB's own banknote-history page was fetched and did not surface this note's text in the excerpt retrieved. Pin is the Academy building shown on the reverse, not a bank office.
